component.name: LUCY Diagnose
component.summary: Inspect system health and diagnostic capabilities

description.p: LUCY Diagnose is a read-only system diagnostics application with a native GTK interface. Review system health, storage, networking, audio and screen-sharing prerequisites in one dashboard.

Choose from thirteen themes and explicitly export privacy-filtered Markdown or JSON reports. AI handoff requires fresh consent. Flatpak reports restricted host capabilities and never requests elevated privileges.
